message.content:
### Building a New PC – Step‑by‑Step Guide

Below is a practical, beginner‑friendly walkthrough.  
Feel free to skip sections you already know, but keep the safety and order in mind.

| # | What to Do | Why It Matters | Tips |
|---|------------|----------------|------|
| **1** | **Plan & Budget** | Know what you’ll use it for (gaming, video editing, office work). | List required specs: CPU, GPU, RAM, storage, PSU, case, cooling. |
| **2** | **Gather Parts** | All components must be compatible. | Use a PC builder tool (e.g., PCPartPicker) to check compatibility. |
| **3** | **Prepare Workspace** | Clean, static‑free area. | Anti‑static wrist strap or mat; avoid carpet. |
| **4** | **Open the Case** | Access motherboard, power supply, etc. | Remove side panels, unscrew screws. |
| **5** | **Install the Power Supply (PSU)** | Supplies power to all components. | Align with rear exhaust, screw in, route cables. |
| **6** | **Mount the Motherboard** | Base for all components. | Align standoffs, screw in, leave ports exposed. |
| **7** | **Install the CPU** | Central processing unit. | Open socket latch, align pin/land pattern, gently place, lock latch. |
| **8** | **Apply Thermal Paste & Install CPU Cooler** | Keeps CPU from overheating. | Use a pea‑size amount; spread evenly. Attach cooler, secure. |
| **9** | **Insert RAM Modules** | Memory for multitasking. | Open DIMM slots, align notch, press until clicks. |
| **10** | **Mount Storage (SSD/HDD)** | Data storage. | For M.2 SSDs: slide into slot, screw. For 2.5” drives: use drive cage or brackets. |
| **11** | **Install the Graphics Card (GPU)** | Handles rendering for games, video, etc. | Slide into PCI‑e x16 slot, secure with screw, connect power cables. |
| **12** | **Connect Power Cables** | Power all components. | 24‑pin ATX, 8‑pin EPS, PCI‑e power, SATA power, etc. |
| **13** | **Connect Data Cables** | Data transfer between components. | SATA data cables, M.2 connectors, USB headers, front panel connectors. |
| **14** | **Cable Management** | Improves airflow, aesthetics. | Tuck cables behind motherboard tray, use zip ties. |
| **15** | **Close the Case** | Protect components, finish look. | Screw side panels back on. |
| **16** | **First Boot & BIOS Setup** | Verify hardware, set boot order. | Press power button, enter BIOS (usually F2, DEL, ESC). |
| **17** | **Install Operating System (OS)** | Turn your PC into a usable machine. | Use USB installer (Windows, Linux). Follow on‑screen prompts. |
| **18** | **Install Drivers & Updates** | Ensure hardware works optimally. | Download latest drivers from manufacturer sites. |
| **19** | **Test & Benchmark** | Verify performance, stability. | Run stress tests (Prime95, 3DMark). |
| **20** | **Enjoy & Maintain** | Keep system running smoothly. | Clean dust every 3–6 months, update software. |

---

#### Detailed Tips & Common Pitfalls

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| **Static Damage** | Use an anti‑static wrist strap or touch a grounded metal object before handling components. |
| **CPU Overheating** | Ensure cooler is properly seated; use high‑quality thermal paste. |
| **Insufficient Power** | Double‑check PSU wattage; use a PSU calculator. |
| **Component Misalignment** | Verify standoff placement; use a motherboard standoff template. |
| **Cable Clutter** | Plan cable routes early; use Velcro straps or zip ties. |
| **BIOS Not Detecting Drives** | Check SATA mode (AHCI vs IDE), ensure cables are firmly connected. |
| **GPU Not Recognized** | Confirm power connectors are attached; try a different PCI‑e slot. |

---

#### Quick Reference: Common Component Types

| Component | Typical Use | Example |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| **CPU** | Processor | Intel Core i7‑13700K, AMD Ryzen 9 7950X |
| **Motherboard** | Platform | ASUS ROG Strix Z790-E, MSI MPG B650 Tomahawk |
| **RAM** | Memory | Corsair Vengeance LPX 32GB DDR5-6000 |
| **Storage** | SSD/HDD | Samsung 980 Pro 1TB NVMe, Seagate Barracuda 2TB HDD |
| **GPU** | Graphics | NVIDIA RTX 4090, AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT |
| **PSU** | Power | EVGA SuperNOVA 850W 80+ Gold |
| **Case** | Enclosure | NZXT H510, Fractal Design Meshify C |
| **Cooler** | CPU cooling | Noctua NH-D15, Corsair H100i RGB |

---

#### Resources

- **PCPartPicker** – Build & compare parts, check compatibility.  
- **YouTube Channels** – Linus Tech Tips, JayzTwoCents, Paul's Hardware.  
- **Reddit** – r/buildapc for community help.  
- **Manufacturer Manuals** – Always read the motherboard, PSU, and GPU manuals.

---

### Final Checklist Before First Boot

1. **All screws tightened** – Motherboard, PSU, GPU, drives.  
2. **All cables connected** – Power, data, front panel.  
3. **No loose screws or tools inside case** – Prevent short circuits.  
4. **Power button functioning** – Test with a simple “power on” test.  

Once you pass this checklist, power on, enter BIOS, and you’re ready to install your OS. Happy building!
